$description: BottomSheetNav (platform/patterns/BottomSheetNav, library wave 7, lane C): its component tokens, the grid of tiles. The sheet, the list and the tiles' states are the Sheet's, NavList's and RowButton's own tokens.

bottom-sheet-nav-tile-min-width.$description: BottomSheetNav: a tile's narrowest width (three or four to a row on a phone).

bottom-sheet-nav-tile-min-height.$description: BottomSheetNav: a tile's least height (well over the touch target).

bottom-sheet-nav-tile-radius.$description: BottomSheetNav: a tile's corners (its hover and selected fill).

bottom-sheet-nav-tile-padding-block.$description: BottomSheetNav: the space above the icon and under the label.

bottom-sheet-nav-tile-padding-inline.$description: BottomSheetNav: the space beside the label.

bottom-sheet-nav-tile-gap.$description: BottomSheetNav: the space between a tile's icon and its label.

bottom-sheet-nav-tile-current-icon-color.$description: BottomSheetNav: the current place's icon (filled), as in the bottom navigation bar.

bottom-sheet-nav-tile-label-font-family.$description: BottomSheetNav: a tile label's typeface (UI text).

bottom-sheet-nav-tile-label-font-size.$description: BottomSheetNav: a tile label's size (as the bottom navigation bar's labels).

bottom-sheet-nav-tile-label-line-height.$description: BottomSheetNav: a tile label's line height.
